appearances.whereabouts: aboard the Spray traveling down the Arinelle; in his nightmares in maze-like dream environments
appearances.notable_actions: experiences recurring nightmares of Ba'alzamon pursuing him through mazes; wakes with a bleeding finger from a thorn prick that occurred in the dream; climbs to the top of the ship's mast and sits there fearlessly; slides down the forestay; converses with Mat about the dagger and their dreams; takes juggling lessons from Thom
appearances.demeanor: troubled by dreams and mysterious changes in himself; exhilarated when at height of mast; concerned about companions left behind; worried about going mad

appearances.whereabouts: in Rand's dreams, pursuing him through maze-like environments
appearances.notable_actions: hunts Rand through dream mazes; confronts Rand directly; declares Rand is his and threatens him; attempts to touch/capture Rand before being disrupted when Rand calls it a dream
appearances.demeanor: relentless, threatening, commanding, possessive of Rand

appearances.whereabouts: aboard the Spray, often sitting in the bows
appearances.notable_actions: keeps the stolen dagger from Shadar Logoth hidden under his coat; slides it in and out of its sheath repeatedly; makes Rand promise not to tell anyone about it; admits to having nightmares like Rand's but refuses to discuss them; shows interest in the metal tower and treasure; broods alone much of the time
appearances.demeanor: withdrawn, secretive, brooding, defensive about the dagger, fixated on treasure

appearances.notable_actions: entertains the crew with stories and songs to prevent mutiny; teaches Rand and Mat gleeman skills (juggling, tumbling, flute, stories); climbs the mast to bring Rand down; watches the crew carefully for signs of trouble; convinces Captain Domon that Rand's mast-climbing was part of training
appearances.demeanor: watchful, protective, concerned for the boys' safety, pedagogical

appearances.whereabouts: aboard the Spray, commanding the vessel down the Arinelle
appearances.notable_actions: drives the crew hard to maintain speed downriver; uses captured Trolloc weapons as reminders when crew grumbles; refuses to put to shore; shares stories with Rand about wonders of the world (metal tower, Tremalking stone hand, Tanchico animal bones, etc.); watches Rand's mast antics with concern
appearances.demeanor: driven, urgent, demanding, knowledgeable about world geography and wonders, somewhat paternal toward the boys

appearances.whereabouts: aboard the Spray, assigned to solitary filthy tasks
appearances.notable_actions: attempts to blame Rand, Mat, and Thom for the Trolloc attack; scrubs galley pots and crawls in bilges; stops talking to anyone after crew rejection; watches Rand, Mat, and Thom with murderous intent
appearances.demeanor: defensive, resentful, injured, sullen, murderous toward the passengers

appearances.whereabouts: aboard the Spray working on deck
appearances.notable_actions: rejects Gelb's attempts to blame the passengers; tells Gelb to go away; spits on Gelb's foot
